    """Calculates the number of inversions in a permutation p (1-indexed)."""
    n = len(p)
    count = 0
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(i + 1, n):
            if p[i] > p[j]:

    return count

def rotate(p, r):
    """Rotates permutation p by r positions to the left (0 <= r < N)."""
    N = len(p)
    return p[r:] + p[:r]

    """
    Calculates d(A, B) = min_r d(A, r(B)), where d is inversion distance.
    A and B are lists representing permutations (e.g., [1, 2, ..., N]).
